long_description: Aims Max Gardenia Golf City is a landmark ready-to-move-in residential township spread over a sprawling 80 acres in Central Noida, Sector 75. Developed by Aims Max Gardenia Developers Pvt. Ltd., the project houses over 900 apartments across 25 magnificent towers. Designed with a distinct 'golf-centric' lifestyle, nearly 80% of the project's layout is dedicated to beautifully manicured green expanses, water bodies, and outdoor activity courts. Residents enjoy premium facilities including an Olympic-length adult swimming pool, a separate toddler pool with slides, a grand central clubhouse with a restaurant, and a highly active sports complex featuring lawn tennis and basketball zones. The project's location is a massive highlight, sitting just 500 meters from the Sector 50 Aqua Line Metro Station and directly across the newly opened Medanta Super-Speciality Hospital.
